result.title: Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction
result.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Knowledge-Enhanced Information Retrieval (KEIR) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
result.summary: Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建科学概念图（节点为 LLM 从论文文本抽取的细粒度概念、边为共现），提出 MiroGraph 多智能体框架：特征设计 agent 从结构、语义、趋势角度设计预测特征，三个 LLM agent 在概念对的子图上计算特征值，再由分类器设计 agent 构建分类器预测概念对影响力，并配套 CIKM/KDD/SIGIR 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先由 agent 决定抽取哪些特征、再在子图上计算取值」的两段式流程，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、潜在状态该携带何种任务信息的问题相通，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及多模态或 latent 推理状态，联系属推测。
